name: Paperflite
description_en:
Paperflite organizes and distributes sales/marketing content through a searchable hub and personalized collections. A seller can assemble approved documents, videos and links into a recipient-specific experience rather than attach a pile of files. Paid tiers add CRM/email integration, deal rooms and more tailored enterprise capabilities.

The current homepage markets a broader revenue-enablement family that also names Cleverstory for interactive content and Heysales for coaching. This record focuses on the Paperflite hub, collection and distribution workflow; it does not assume every family product or AI coaching feature is included in a Paperflite seat.
description_zh:
Paperflite通过可搜索内容中心及个性化集合组织、分发销售/营销资料。销售可将获准文档、视频及链接组合为面向特定收件人的体验，无需发送一堆附件；付费档位增加CRM/邮件集成、交易资料室及定制企业能力。

当前首页宣传更广的营收赋能产品家族，同时列Cleverstory互动内容与Heysales辅导。本记录聚焦Paperflite内容中心、集合及分发流程，不假定家族全部产品或AI辅导都包含在Paperflite席位中。

core_features.explanation_en: Curate assets from existing streams/collections, local uploads or links, choose an experience/viewer and save before sharing.
core_features.explanation_zh: 可从既有流/集合、本地上传或链接选资料，选择体验/查看器并保存后分享。

core_features.explanation_en: Starter lists storage synchronization, AI discovery/SEEK and per-asset analytics; CRM-level views depend on higher tiers.
core_features.explanation_zh: Starter列存储同步、AI查找/SEEK和逐资产分析，CRM内分析取决于更高档。

core_features.name_zh: 账户默认值及分享控制
core_features.explanation_en: Administrators configure collection appearance, download/reshare and default gating, with a documented user-level gating choice at link generation.
core_features.explanation_zh: 管理员配置集合外观、下载/转发及默认留资门槛，文档同时允许用户生成链接时调整门槛。

pricing.summary_zh: 显示月付席位价$30/$50/$60，年付月均$27.50/$47.50/$57，最低5用户；Enterprise报价，币种/税/所选条款未知，未核实持续免费版。

sources.title: AI-Native Revenue Enablement Platform for Modern Sellers

official_check.scope: Public primary sources read; no account, purchase, integration execution, performance benchmark, owner identity or publication approval tested.

review_notes: Original English synthesis and corresponding Chinese translation from the attached primary sources. Vendor documentation does not establish independent testing or customer outcomes.
Original directory feature labels were replaced with product-specific documented capabilities. Unknowns and unreviewed alternatives remain unknown.

sections.title_en: Package a relevant content sequence for one buyer
sections.title_zh: 为一个买方组合相关资料顺序
sections.en:
For an illustrative procurement follow-up, select an approved product overview, a technical explainer and an existing case study from the hub. In Collections, create a named collection, choose its experience and recipient viewer, add the assets and save. The guide also permits dragging in local files or adding a web URL. This is a collection workflow, not a promise that every external URL is copied, archived or available offline.

Test the recipient view and permissions before sending. The guide describes mixed formats including documents, presentations, video and links, but this research did not upload or convert a file, test a viewer, or measure engagement. Materials still need the appropriate sharing rights and editorial approval.
sections.zh:
例如采购跟进，可从内容中心选择获准产品介绍、技术说明和现有案例。在Collections中新建命名集合、选择体验及收件人查看器、加入资料并保存；指南也允许拖入本地文件或添加网页URL。这是集合流程，不保证所有外部URL都会复制、归档或离线可用。

发送前应测试收件人视图和权限。指南描述文档、演示、视频和链接等混合格式，本次未上传/转换文件、测试查看器或测量互动；资料仍需适当分享权及编辑批准。

sections.title_en: Treat a default gate as a configurable setting
sections.title_zh: 将默认门槛视为可配置设置
sections.en:
Administrators can set account branding and collection defaults such as banner, description and CTA, with Metro/Carousel/Bento experience choices. Share settings cover downloading, resharing and a default gate when an anonymous collection link is generated.

The same article says a user can control gating when generating a link. A default is therefore not evidence that every shared collection is unconditionally gated. Establish who can change the setting and inspect the actual generated link as an anonymous recipient. Confirm expiry, authentication, download and forwarding behavior for sensitive content; those specific protections were not tested or universally established by this article.
sections.zh:
管理员可设置账户品牌及集合默认横幅、说明和CTA，并有Metro/Carousel/Bento体验选项；分享设置涉及下载、转发及匿名集合链接生成时的默认门槛。

同文也称用户生成链接时可控制门槛，因此默认设置不能证明每个共享集合都无条件受限。应明确谁能修改，并以匿名收件人检查实际链接；敏感资料需确认到期、认证、下载及转发行为，本次未测试或从该文建立普遍保护保证。

sections.title_en: Budget the required tier and minimum seat commitment
sections.title_zh: 预算所需档位及最低席位承诺
sections.en:
The pricing page displays monthly per-user amounts of$30Starter,$50Professional and$60Advanced. The annual group displays$27.50,$47.50and$57per user/month, each with a five-user minimum. Confirm currency, billing total, minimums for the chosen monthly offer, taxes and renewal before purchase. Enterprise is quoted; no continuous free plan was established.

Starter lists a content hub, personalized microsites, storage sync, SEEK and asset analytics. Professional adds CRM/email integrations, secure distribution, CRM analytics, branding, SSO and a customer-success manager. Advanced adds recommendations, personalization, digital deal rooms, predictive insights and priority support. Enterprise adds deeper/custom integration, reporting, localization and training. Family-level interactive content/coaching claims should be checked against the written package, not added to these tiers by implication.
sections.zh:
定价页显示每用户月付Starter$30、Professional$50、Advanced$60；年付组显示每用户月均$27.50、$47.50和$57，均标最低五用户。购买前需确认币种、账单总额、所选月付方案最低人数、税及续费。Enterprise需报价，未建立持续免费版。

Starter列内容中心、个性化微站、存储同步、SEEK及资产分析；Professional增加CRM/邮件集成、安全分发、CRM分析、品牌、SSO及客户成功经理；Advanced增加推荐、个性化、交易资料室、预测洞察及优先支持；Enterprise增加深度/定制集成、报告、本地化及培训。家族层级互动内容/辅导需核对书面套餐，不能暗含到上述各档。

sections.title_en: Plan subscription changes and content retrieval
sections.title_zh: 规划订阅变更及内容取回
sections.en:
The pricing FAQ says plan changes and switches between monthly/annual billing take effect at the next billing cycle. Additional users can be added with prorated charges for the remaining period. It also says data remains accessible for30days after termination to export or retrieve files. That is a vendor-described retrieval window, not a tested backup, permanent archive or guaranteed export of every analytics/configuration field.

Before onboarding, ask what can be exported, in what format, who can do it and when access ends. Test sample file retrieval and maintain original source assets. The publicSOC2TypeII/encryption/security statements were not independently audited, and no retention/deletion contract, data residency orAItraining terms were inspected here.
sections.zh:
定价FAQ称套餐变更及月付/年付切换在下一账期生效，增加用户按剩余账期比例收费；也称终止后数据仍可访问30天，供导出或取回文件。这是厂商描述的取回窗口，不是已测试备份、永久归档或保证导出所有分析/配置字段。

接入前应确认可导出什么、格式、操作权限及何时失去访问，测试样本文件取回，并保留原始资产。本次未独立审计公开SOC2TypeII/加密/安全主张，也未检查保留/删除合同、数据区域或AI训练条款。

sections.title_en: Evaluate enablement rather than a general website CMS
sections.title_zh: 按销售赋能需求评估，而非通用网站CMS
sections.en:
Paperflite is plausible for a team curating reusable collateral and buyer-specific collections, especially where CRM distribution and feedback matter. It is not automatically a replacement for an application CMS, source document editor or complete learning/coaching system. The current brand groups Paperflite, Cleverstory and Heysales; confirm product boundaries, licenses and data flow when combining them.

A useful pilot is a small approved library, one buyer collection, an actual role/gating test, the required CRM/email connection and a retrieval exercise. Engagement signals andAIrecommendations should be interpreted with context, not treated as proof of intent or won revenue. No account, external share, CRM sync, AI answer, analytics attribution or export was executed.
sections.zh:
需复用资料及面向买方组合内容、尤其重视CRM分发和反馈的团队可评估Paperflite。它不自动替代应用CMS、源文档编辑器或完整学习/辅导系统。当前品牌组合Paperflite、Cleverstory和Heysales，合用时需确认产品边界、许可及数据流。

试点可包括少量获准资料、一个买方集合、真实角色/门槛测试、所需CRM/邮件连接及取回练习。互动信号和AI推荐应结合语境解读，不能当作购买意图或成交收入证明。本次未执行账户、外部分享、CRM同步、AI回答、分析归因或导出。
